metadata.name: workspace-quality-hero
metadata.description: Phase-4 analysis-breadth journey driving the pure-Go quality_assessment op end-to-end against the real backend: navigates to /workspace, switches to Analyze mode, selects the Quality action (discovered from AnalysisService.ListAnalysisOperations), loads an image, and runs it. Because quality_assessment is pure-Go (no model — like probe and duplicate_detect), the run resolves SYNCHRONOUSLY to a real QualityResult (overall score + sharpness/blurry + brightness/exposure + contrast + notes) with NO install gate. Asserting the quality result view renders proves the full discovery -> sync analyze edge (POST /api/v1/analysis/quality_assessment) -> AnalyzeResponse oneof parse (quality case) -> QualityView render wiring works against the live API. A broken analysis discovery, a regressed analyze edge, the new oneof case failing to parse, or a result that never renders all fail here. This is a TRUE green success path, not an install gate.

assert.failure_message: The Quality action did not render — AnalysisService.ListAnalysisOperations discovery did not surface the new quality_assessment breadth op.

evaluate.expression: (() => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 240; c.height = 160; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.fillStyle = '#3b6ea5'; g.fillRect(0, 0, 240, 160); g.fillStyle = '#f0c419'; g.fillRect(40, 30, 160, 100); return new Promise((resolve) => { c.toBlob((blob) => { const file = new File([blob], 'sample.png', { type: 'image/png' }); const input = document.querySelector('[data-testid="workspace-file-input"]'); const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(file); input.files = dt.files; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); resolve('loaded'); }, 'image/png'); }); })()
